# Washington Luis Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu

> Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu academy in Deer Park, Texas for all ages: Little Ninjas, Juniors, Adult Gi and No-Gi, Adult Striking, Women Only, and private lessons. Led by Professor Washington Luis, 3rd degree black belt and two-time Master World Champion. Your first class is free.

Also known as: Washington Luis BJJ, WLBJJ, Academia Washington Luis.

- Address: 4202 Center St, Deer Park, TX 77536
- Phone / text: (832) 908-1968
- Email: mike.wlbjj@gmail.com
- Front desk hours: Mon-Fri 4:30 PM - 8:30 PM, Sat 9:30 AM - 12:30 PM, closed Sundays
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/academy_wlbjj/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/academiawlbjj/
